description: A telephone keypad: a gate on any of the twelve key jacks plays that key's dial tone pair, or a drum sample when a kit is chosen from the menu

outputs.text: Everything sounding at that moment, mixed together

notes: There are no controls on this panel: nothing sounds until a gate arrives at one of the key inputs.
menu: Original Firmware — the keys play dial tone pairs, which is where the module starts
Alt Firmware — a submenu of twenty-four drum machines, each of which maps twelve of its samples onto the twelve keys
